caseNameFull: Smith v. Commercial Travelers Mutual Accident Association of America
attorneys: Owen W. Crumpacker and Jay E. Darlington for petitioner. L. L. Bomberger and John W. Morthland for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion that the petition should be granted.
